== Notes ==
* Attacks made under Choking Gas will interrupt foes regardless of whether the arrows hit or not, e.g. if the ranger is [[blind]] or the foe [[block]]s.
* [[Practiced Stance]] can be used to lengthen the skill's short [[duration]], which is, unlike most preparations, shorter than its  [[recharge time]].
* The concise description does not state that this preparation works only with a [[bow]].
